Name: QUANG Ridgeside Village Retexture
Author: duongquang
Description:
I made this mod because I wanted to improve the visuals of the RSV mod according to my style. If you don't like an image let me know. If it makes sense I will fix it.

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Install all the required mods. ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher ﻿[/url])[/*]
[*]Unzip the file then put it into Stardew Valley\Mods.[/*]
[*]Play game.[/*]
[*]If you download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url], can turn on/off  all item textures you want in the game.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]or[/b][/size]

[b]After downloading and extracting the mod, cut and paste all the files from the Assets folder into the RSV mod. (This way, you won't need an additional mod.)[/b]
